title.suggested: Joe Goss Posts $500 Forfeit for Match With Tom Allen

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican, reprinting the Cincinnati Commercial, reported that Joe Goss had posted a $500 forfeit with Eph Holland at the Empire saloon for a summer fight with Tom Allen, who was expected to cover it promptly.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Republican, Monday Morning, May 1, 1876'; filed as the Missouri Republican per rubric.
